tagline.text: Cebu’s gateway for planning terminals, arrivals, connections and onward transport

location.label: Location
location.text: Terminals 1 and 2, Mactan–Cebu International Airport, Pusok, Lapu-Lapu City, Mactan

best_season.label: Best time to visit
best_season.text: Use according to flight schedules year-round; check weather, holidays and road traffic

duration.label: Time needed
duration.text: Allow the airline’s recommended processing or connection time; shop only with time remaining

children.text: Mactan–Cebu International Airport is Cebu’s gateway in Lapu-Lapu City on Mactan Island. Distinguish domestic-focused T1 from international-focused T2, using flight screens, transfer desks and ground-transport signs to organize the first and last travel days. T2’s wave-shaped timber roof adds an architectural point of interest.

Despite its Cebu name, the airport is on Mactan Island rather than in central Cebu City. The first transfer depends on whether the destination is a Mactan resort, city hotel or port. Before leaving arrivals, establish the precise address, contact method, suitable vehicle and practical payment arrangements.

The broad orientation is T1 for domestic and T2 for international travel, subject to the flight’s current terminal instruction. One airline may use different terminals for different routes. Use the booking, airline alerts and flight screens rather than an old airline list or photographed gate number. The representative pin marks T2, not a specific road gate or boarding gate.

The airport combines architectural interest with controlled processing and security zones. Shops or seating beyond departure checks are not automatically accessible to arriving passengers or companions. Complete the necessary route planning before using spare time for photographs or food, following local camera restrictions in processing areas.

Repeating high arches and lower eaves echo the surrounding sea. Observe the facade from a permitted departure approach and the roof rhythm where the interior is accessible. There is no need to enter a road lane or restricted apron for the view; keep pickup routes clear.

blocks.title: Read the terminal and security boundaries

children.text: Locate the correct terminal, then follow check-in, baggage, relevant processing, security and boarding signs. On arrival, complete baggage collection and formalities before agreeing on the exit meeting point. Current Arrivals, Departures and Transfer signs are more useful than an old floor-by-floor description.

blocks.title: Check screens instead of relying on announcements

children.text: The airline describes CEB as a silent airport with reduced announcements. Recheck the flight number, destination, gate and boarding status even while eating or using a phone. Departure time differs from boarding cutoff. Move promptly after a gate change rather than expecting the short queues seen in a photograph.

blocks.title: Begin connections at the transfer guidance

children.text: Cebu Connect does not make every ticket or airline combination equivalent. Ask the desk about the onward flight and baggage connection, including any new check-in needed on separate tickets. A published minimum connection time is not a personal buffer or a guarantee after delays.

blocks.title: Match food, gifts and rest to the accessible zone

children.text: Look for food, gifts and seating within the terminal and security zone actually available. Keep a short wait simple; for a longer stay, confirm current lounge access and operation. As checked in November 2026, Plaza Premium posts renovation and interim-location notices for both terminals, so old lounge photographs or directions may be unsuitable.

blocks.title: Agree on the exit and vehicle pickup

children.text: Agree on the terminal and actual pickup zone after completing arrival procedures. At both terminals, taxis queue outside arrivals following the signs, with separate lines for white (regular) and yellow (airport-only, higher fare) taxis; the exact bay can change, so confirm with airport staff. Per an August 2026 article, meter flagdown is about ₱50 for white and about ₱70 for yellow, but fares are being revised so meters may differ. Grab pickup areas are also near the arrival areas of both terminals, so follow the ride app’s current directions and verify the vehicle and driver. Gather the group and baggage before requesting the ride. Share the flight, terminal and intended exit with anyone meeting the arrival.

items.title: From an international arrival to accommodation

items.time: First · Follow signs and prepare documents

children.text: Follow the actual arrival route with passport and required registration information ready. Check eligibility and staff guidance for electronic gates rather than assuming every nationality or passport can use a photographed machine.

items.time: Then · Baggage, customs and meeting exit

children.text: Check baggage information and the claim tag, complete necessary customs procedures, then organize communications, cash and the address. Arrange a way to contact the pickup after exiting instead of equating touchdown with immediate roadside readiness.

Compare a suitable vehicle with currently operating public transport. For a bus, establish whether another transfer is needed to reach the hotel. Mactan, central Cebu and southern SRP destinations have different complete journeys.

Plan the road journey around the airline’s arrival advice and check-in, bag-drop and boarding cutoffs. Online check-in may still leave document or baggage steps. Establish the flight route before seeking a meal or lounge.

items.time: After processing · Gate, break and boarding

children.text: After required checks, verify the gate again. Eat nearby and use bathrooms or charging while monitoring boarding. Connecting passengers should confirm the appropriate transfer route before choosing a general exit.

These are orientation examples, subject to actual airline and processing instructions. Follow current screens and staff directions during disruption or security changes, checking separate-ticket connections and re-entry conditions before leaving the airport.

Specify the exact airport terminal. Resort position and road traffic vary even on the same island, so a nearby-hotel description is not a reason to shorten the departure margin. Agree on vehicle capacity, meeting point and contact arrangements for delays.

items.title: From Cebu City, the port or SRP

children.text: Include the bridge-side journey and terminal approach when travelling from mainland Cebu. A driving estimate excludes vehicle dispatch, hotel departure preparation and airport processing. From a port, separate actual ferry arrival, baggage exit and the road journey.

Compare public transport using the current airport route, boarding point and fare. SM City Cebu and SM Seaside are different malls, so retain the complete terminus name. Distinguish Cebu services from similarly branded venues in Manila and include the final hotel leg in the comparison.

T1 and T2 are separate buildings. Do not assume direct movement between secure areas with baggage; ask about the transfer route, shuttle or pedestrian segment appropriate to the ticket. Arrange mobility assistance with the airline ahead of time and tell staff the next terminal and required support.

Follow current lift and accessible-route signs. With strollers, wheelchairs or substantial baggage, establish the lift and waiting location instead of following escalators alone. Photographs record facilities at capture, with present operation and assistance confirmed on site.

Time the visit around the flight rather than the view. Check current airline arrival advice and cutoffs, allowing for holidays, peak traffic and rain. A silent airport means fewer announcements, not continuously short processing or road queues.

A night flight does not mean every restaurant, exchange counter, lounge or storage desk shares its hours. Verify the required service’s terminal, security zone and cutoff. A renovation target or equipment rollout plan does not establish full availability.

items.label: Flights, taxes, lounges, lodging and baggage
items.note: Confirm ticket, eligibility and service terms

children.text: Costs are approximate for 2026 and may change. These are personal planning allocations rather than verified fares or menu prices.
The four base items total

per person for one ground-transfer leg and refreshments. Add return transport, shopping, lodging and paid services separately. Compare the current exchange or ATM rate, fees and final amount rather than assuming every airport transaction has a fixed disadvantage.

Official eTravel registration itself is free. Check current eligibility and registration timing at etravel.gov.ph and save the registration details. Distinguish it from ticket taxes, travel tax or terminal charges rather than paying unrelated items together.

For a late arrival or early flight, compare complete journeys from a Mactan or city base. A nearby hotel does not automatically provide walking access, an indoor link or a free shuttle. Confirm its entrance, early pickup and meal arrangements, with a contact method for flight delays.

Choose food within the area currently accessible. A meal with companions before processing differs from a quick stop near the gate afterward. Keep flight information in view while waiting for food and verify the photographed restaurant’s current menu and hours independently.

For a long wait, consider Aerotel or a lounge only after confirming the terminal, security zone and actual availability. Plaza Premium posts T1 and T2 renovation and interim-space notices in November 2026. Check showers, storage and sleep arrangements separately instead of assuming they form a free standard service.
Save the flight, terminal and destination, checking screens and airline alerts frequently at the silent airport.
Arrange the actual pickup after gathering the group and baggage, agreeing on the precise point with the driver.
Establish baggage and onward-flight procedures before choosing a general airport exit during a connection.
Keep the phone charged with registration, booking and address information available if connectivity fails.
Arrange mobility support with the airline beforehand and describe the terminal and assistance needed to staff.
Use current government and airline entry, security and baggage rules rather than an old visa, tax or allowance table.

Protect passports, boarding passes and personal QR codes and follow processing-area camera restrictions.
Verify the driver and plate, destination and payment terms before boarding the confirmed vehicle.
Aircraft and old flight signs do not establish current routes; reconfirm services and terminals for the booking date.
Explore the island’s resorts and heritage sites, checking the complete transfer and current access for each destination.
Continue to central heritage, food and shopping on mainland Cebu, allowing separately for arrival procedures and the bridge journey.
